name: Smartberry C005 SIM Supported Kids Smart Watch
description:
Specifications:
Charging Type: 2PIN charging, magnetic suction for effortless and secure charging.
Display: 1.44-inch LCD with a resolution of 128*128 TN, ensuring clear visibility.
Battery: Built-in 520mA battery with wire bonding for lasting power.
Connectivity: Options include Bluetooth and USB 2.0, enhancing versatile connectivity.
OS Compatibility: Compatible with both Android and iOS devices, ensuring broad usability.
Special Features: SIM support adds a layer of independence to the device.
Memory: 32MB RAM combined with 24MB storage for efficient performance.
